messages.subject: Project Falcon - draft Term Sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Marcus,

Please find attached the draft term sheet for the Series B. Key points: £14m raise at £56m pre / £70m post, £14.00 per Series B Preferred Share, 1x non-participating liquidation preference, broad-based weighted-average anti-dilution, one Investor Director for Westbridge, and the option pool enlarged to 13% post-money pre-completion.

Warranty cap proposed at the investment amount (£14m company / £4m per founder as an opening position). 45-day exclusivity. Grateful for comments.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
